audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Aspartylglucosaminuria is linked to the gene AGA, and alpha-mannosidosis to the gene MAN2B1, both in curated databases [e_e61c6fe8615d] [e_d7440f028524].
So the two diseases have different genes in these edges [e_e61c6fe8615d] [e_d7440f028524].
Constellate still computed that their listed symptoms overlap somewhat, with a score of 0.247 (simGIC) [e_d3b5bf10c20f].
That overlap is inferred by calculation and is not a diagnosis [e_d3b5bf10c20f].
For aspartylglucosaminuria, a reduced level of the enzyme aspartylglucosaminidase in tissue is an observed feature [e_45645b340bab].
For alpha-mannosidosis, one trial in young children is listed as recruiting, and another trial is listed as withdrawn [e_14334716209a] [e_3c267533a8ab].
A listed trial shows that research exists and does not show that a treatment works [e_14334716209a].
These edges list no trial for aspartylglucosaminuria [e_e61c6fe8615d].
